categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains notices for acquiring specific land parcels for public projects (Awissawella Water Supply Scheme) and corrections to previous land acquisition notices. The content focuses entirely on land descriptions, boundaries, claimants, and acquisition procedures without involving government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories like legal frameworks or commercial matters.
